metadata.name: quantum_hooks
metadata.description: Quant Pad Quantum Hooks: creator-fee routing for Meteora coins

accounts.name: damm_program
docs: position and NFT account (addresses stored by `sync`), plus the pool's vaults.

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the upgrade authority may initialize, so nobody can front-run the deploy.

accounts.name: well_wsol_ata
docs: is closed back into the well afterwards (the well pays and recovers its rent).

accounts.name: mint
docs: The fresh mint keypair Meteora's DBC initialises right after this instruction (DBC's
`base_mint` must sign too, so nobody else can create the coin's pool). Its signature binds
the hooks to whoever creates the coin.

accounts.name: damm_config
docs: account to record once the coin has migrated (verified in the handler).

errors.name: InvalidAllocation

errors.name: TooManySplits
errors.msg: At most 4 Superposition splits are allowed

errors.name: InvalidSplitBps

errors.name: InvalidSplitWallet

errors.name: InvalidLockTerms

errors.name: LockTermsMismatch

fields.name: venue
docs: 0 = Meteora DBC bonding curve, 1 = DAMM v2 pool.

fields.name: claim_delay
docs: Seconds between posting an Entanglement epoch and its first claim: the authority's window
to `cancel_epoch` a bad root (0..=MAX_CLAIM_DELAY).

fields.name: version
docs: Incremented by every config change (`update_config`, `set_paused`, `set_launch_configs`).
`update_config` names the version it was prepared against, so a stale update cannot undo a
later change.

fields.name: launch_configs
docs: Quant Pad's Meteora DBC configs: `register` only binds hooks to a pool launched under one
of these (DBC configs are immutable, so the address pins every curve and fee setting).

fields.name: version
docs: The config version after this change.

fields.name: claim_start
docs: `created_at + config.claim_delay`: claims open here; until then the authority may cancel.

fields.name: bitmap
docs: One bit per leaf, `ceil(leaf_count / 8)` bytes.

types.name: EpochCancelled
docs: The authority cancelled an epoch before its claims opened: `returned` went back to the
Entanglement reserve and the account's rent to `rent_to` (`config.keeper`).

fields.name: claim_start
docs: Claims open here (`created_at + config.claim_delay`); until then the authority may cancel.

fields.name: liquidity_added
docs: Liquidity added to the well's DAMM v2 position and permanently locked.

types.name: Harvested
docs: `harvest` claimed the creator side's fees into the well.

fields.name: legs
docs: Bitmask of the legs that ran (1 trading fee, 2 surplus, 4 migration fee, 8 LP fee).

fields.name: claimed
docs: Quote (SOL) claimed into the well, without the WSOL account's rent.

fields.name: tokens_burned
docs: Coin tokens received (only if a fee mode ever pays base) and burned.

fields.name: rent_refunded
docs: Rent of the WSOL account returned to `caller`.

fields.name: version
docs: The config version after this change.

fields.name: collected
docs: Unallocated lamports this pulse distributed (`available`; 0 when below the 0.001 SOL floor
and the pulse only paid owed amounts).

fields.name: protocol
docs: Paid to the treasury, launcher and splits by this pulse, including amounts owed from
earlier pulses (`owed_paid` of the total).

fields.name: deferred
docs: Shares this pulse could not pay: the recipient would stay below its rent-exempt minimum
(recorded as owed to it and paid first once it can receive), or a split is a key that can
never be paid (reserved or executable; stays in the well unledgered and is re-pulsed).

fields.name: owed_paid
docs: Owed amounts from earlier pulses paid by this one.

fields.name: planned_cliff_secs
docs: Lock terms committed at registration (0/0 = none planned). `lock` must use them.

fields.name: last_epoch_at
docs: When the newest Entanglement epoch was posted (0 = never); paces `post_entanglement`.

fields.name: graduated_at
docs: When the coin's bonding curve filled (DBC `finish_curve_timestamp`, recorded by `sync`;
0 = not yet).

fields.name: split_owed
docs: Shares `pulse` owes but could not pay yet (the recipient would stay below its rent-exempt
minimum). Held in the well and paid first once the recipient can receive.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: The DBC config the coin launches under (allow-listed at `register`) and the virtual pool
that config derives for the mint.

fields.name: damm_pool
docs: The DAMM v2 pool the curve migrated into, the well's position in it and the account holding
that position's NFT, recorded and verified by `sync` (default until the coin migrates).

fields.name: bound_at
docs: When `sync` first saw the well as the DBC pool's creator (0 = not bound yet).

fields.name: birth_bound
docs: The well became the creator before the pool's first trade, so the launcher never held a
creator fee (`sync` reads DBC's `has_swap`).

fields.name: migrated_at
docs: When `sync` recorded the DAMM v2 pool. The public Fusion grace counts from here.

fields.name: total_harvested
docs: Quote lamports `harvest` has claimed into the well (rent refunds excluded).

fields.name: total_fused_liquidity
docs: DAMM v2 liquidity Fusion has added to the well's position and locked.

fields.name: lock
docs: Time Dilation terms the later `lock` must use; `None` when no lock is planned.

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: The DBC virtual pool the coin's hooks are bound to.

fields.name: bps
docs: Share of the creator slice in bps.

types.name: Synced
docs: `sync` recorded something new about the coin's Meteora venue.

fields.name: collect_fee_mode
docs: DAMM v2 `collect_fee_mode` of the recorded pool (1 = quote only); 0 before migration.
